p4.title: NextDoor Pros is now live in Canada
p4.excerpt: Our marketplace crosses the Atlantic: homeowners across Canada can now find vetted local pros — coast to coast, from Toronto to Vancouver.
body: NextDoor Pros is now live in Canada. After starting in Cameroon, we've opened our first market abroad — and we didn't do it halfway. All ten provinces and three territories are covered from day one, with roughly a hundred cities already on the map, from Toronto, Montréal, and Vancouver to Halifax, Winnipeg, Regina, Whitehorse, and Iqaluit.

Nothing about our standard changes with the border. Every pro joining the Canadian network goes through the same screening as everyone else: identity verification, credential and reference checks where they apply, and a review of real past work. Prices and payments are handled in Canadian dollars, and you still reach pros the same safe way — through the platform, without ever trading personal phone numbers or emails.

To browse Canadian pros, open the country switcher in the top bar and choose Canada, then pick your city. If you're a homeowner, you can start looking today. And if you're a skilled pro anywhere in Canada, applications are open — joining now means being among the first names customers see as each city fills out.

p1.title: Now live in Douala, Yaoundé, and Bafoussam
p1.excerpt: We're live in three cities — find vetted local pros in Douala, Yaoundé, and Bafoussam this week.
body: NextDoor Pros is officially live in Douala (Littoral), Yaoundé (Centre), and Bafoussam (West). Starting this week, households in all three cities can browse, compare, and reach out to vetted local pros for everything from plumbing and electrical work to cleaning and home repairs.

Every pro joining these markets goes through the same screening as the rest of our network: identity verification, credential and reference checks where applicable, and a review of past work. We open a city only once we have enough qualified pros to give you real choice — not a thin list of whoever signed up first.

If you're a household in Douala, Yaoundé, or Bafoussam, you can find a pro today. And if you're a skilled pro in any of these regions, applications are open — joining now means getting in front of customers from day one as demand grows.

p2.title: Spring 2026: seasonal services open for booking
p2.excerpt: Lawn care, deck refinishing, and outdoor cleanup pros are taking bookings now.
body: Spring is the busiest stretch of the year for outdoor work, so we've opened seasonal bookings early to help you get on a pro's calendar before the rush. Lawn care, deck refinishing, gutter clearing, pressure washing, and general yard cleanup are all available now.

Booking ahead matters in spring: the best pros fill their schedules quickly once the weather turns. Reserving a slot now locks in your date and your price, and you can message your pro through the platform to confirm details before they arrive.

Not sure where to start? Browse seasonal services by category, read verified reviews from neighbours, and reach out to the pro that fits your timeline and budget. You agree on the details and price directly with them and coordinate everything through the platform.

p3.title: What to expect from a verified NextDoor Pro
p3.excerpt: How we vet every pro on the platform — and why it matters.
body: The "verified" badge on a NextDoor Pro isn't a marketing label — it means the pro has cleared a multi-step screening process before they can take a single booking. Here's what that involves and why it protects you.

First, identity. Every pro confirms who they are before going live, so you always know the person showing up at your door matches their profile. Next, credentials: for trades that require it, we verify active licenses and proof of insurance, so you're not liable if something goes wrong on the job.

Finally, track record. We review past work and surface honest reviews from real customers, and we keep all communication on the platform. That means no sharing personal contact details, and a record you can fall back on if anything needs sorting out.
Verification is ongoing, not one-and-done. Pros who slip below our standards lose their badge — so when you see it, you can book with confidence.
